title: Braun Series 7/8/9 cleaning indicator on
fullDescription:
The yellow shaving-head icon lights when the shaver has logged enough runtime that the foil should be cleaned in the Clean&Charge station, or rinsed under tap water for non-station models.

It is a reminder, not a fault — shaver still works.

fixSteps.title: Place in Clean&Charge
fixSteps.instruction: Push shaver head-first into station; press start.

fixSteps.title: Or rinse manually
fixSteps.instruction: Run head under hot water 30s with shaver running.

fixSteps.title: Press reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power button 5s while light shows to clear indicator manually if cleaning impossible.

faq.q: Is the cleaning fluid worth it?
faq.a: Yes — alcohol-based fluid disinfects and lubricates foils.

title: Foil head LED solid yellow
shortDescription: Cassette has reached 18 months of use.
fullDescription:
Solid yellow foil-head icon (with no flashing) means Braun's usage timer counted ~18 months — Braun's recommended cassette replacement interval. Performance has typically degraded.

Replace cassette and reset timer.

fixSteps.title: Replace cassette
fixSteps.instruction: Press release on side, lift cassette, push new one in.

fixSteps.title: Reset timer
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power button 5 seconds — icon clears.

faq.q: Can I keep using old cassette?
faq.a: Yes but expect more pulling and skin irritation.

title: Braun shaver red battery flash
fullDescription:
Red battery icon flashing means runtime under 5 minutes; quick-charge for one shave is supported by placing on charger 5 minutes for Series 9 / 8 minutes for Series 7.

If flashing red on a fully charged shaver, battery cell pack is failing.

fixSteps.title: Full cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Run shaver until cutoff, then full charge 1 hour.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: If runtime <10 min on full charge, battery needs swap.

whenToCallPro: If you cannot solder; Braun service usually denies battery repair.

faq.a: About 5 years / 1000 cycles.

title: Shaver won't charge in dock or cord
shortDescription: No charge LED with adapter connected.
fullDescription:
Braun shavers use 12V SMPS adapters. If the LED never illuminates, verify adapter output, then clean the contacts at the base of the shaver. Some Series 7 use Smart Plug Type 492-XL — generic chargers will not work.

Clean&Charge station has a separate fuse on the PCB.
symptoms: Dock fluid level light off too

fixSteps.title: Verify adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Multimeter on adapter — should read 12V DC.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe shaver bottom and dock contacts with isopropyl on swab.

fixSteps.title: Try direct cord charge
fixSteps.instruction: Some models accept cord directly into shaver — bypass dock.

whenToCallPro: If both adapter and dock test bad.

faq.a: Match polarity and 1A rating; cheap adapters can damage charge IC.

title: Clean&Charge fluid replacement light
fullDescription:
Clean&Charge cartridge has a chip that the station reads. The droplet icon flashes when the chip reports <10% remaining or after ~30 cleaning cycles.

Use only Braun CCR cartridges — third-party fluids without chip will read empty immediately.

fixSteps.title: Replace cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Pull old, insert genuine Braun CCR.

fixSteps.title: Run priming cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Press start to prime fluid path.

faq.a: Aftermarket refill caps exist; void warranty and chip won't reset.

title: Series 9 motor weak/stalls in dense beard
shortDescription: Linear motor protect-mode triggered by mechanical drag.
fullDescription:
Series 9 uses a linear motor with sonic sensor — it ramps power based on hair density. If the cassette is clogged or foils dented, drag causes the motor to enter protect mode (slow, weak).

Clean cassette and inspect foils for damage.

fixSteps.title: Deep rinse
fixSteps.instruction: Run shaver under hot tap with cassette open.

fixSteps.title: Inspect foils
fixSteps.instruction: Check for dents, holes, raised edges.

fixSteps.title: Replace cassette if damaged
fixSteps.instruction: Swap in new genuine Braun cassette.

whenToCallPro: If new cassette doesn't restore power, motor failed.

faq.a: Use Braun Clean&Charge fluid — pure mineral oil clogs the linear motor.

title: Travel lock engaged
fullDescription:
Holding the power button for 3 seconds engages travel lock; the padlock icon shows and the motor will not start. To unlock, hold power button again 3 seconds — padlock blinks then clears.

Not a fault.

fixSteps.title: Hold power 3s
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold until padlock blinks then clears.

faq.a: Prevents accidental power-on in luggage.

title: Wet/dry shaver water warning
fullDescription:
Series 9 wet/dry models include a moisture sensor under the cassette. Flashing water-drop icon means moisture detected in handle cavity — usually after rinsing without shaking dry.

Leave cassette open and shake water out; dry overnight.

fixSteps.title: Air dry overnight
fixSteps.instruction: Stand cassette open, away from radiator.

whenToCallPro: If water icon persists when fully dry.
videoSearchQuery: Braun Series 9 water drop icon flashing

faq.a: Yes to IPX7 — but the dock is not, never put dock in water.

title: Pop-up trimmer won't extend or retract
fullDescription:
The pop-up trimmer slider on the back of the handle moves a metal cam. Hair and skin oil collect at the slider rails and freeze the mechanism.

Do not force — disassembly cracks the housing.

fixSteps.title: Wet rinse with shaver running
fixSteps.instruction: Run under warm tap with motor on.

fixSteps.title: Work slider gently
fixSteps.instruction: Slide back and forth 20x while wet.

fixSteps.title: Apply Clean&Charge fluid
fixSteps.instruction: Drop a few drops on rails then work slider.

faq.a: No — only Braun CCR fluid or sewing-machine oil.

title: Series 9 system error
fullDescription:
All segment LEDs flashing at once on a Series 9 means the controller failed POST. Usually caused by a brown-out — power-cycle by holding power button 10 seconds with adapter disconnected.

If flashing returns on next power-up, controller PCB is dead.

fixSteps.title: Charge 30 minutes
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in, wait 30 min before powering.

videoSearchQuery: Braun Series 9 all icons flashing reset

faq.a: Yes within 2 years of purchase.

title: C&C fluid empty
fullDescription: Clean & Charge cartridge empty. Common diagnostic on Braun Shaver electric shaver. Resolve by following manufacturer service procedure.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean charging contacts or ports with soft cloth.

whenToCallPro: If reset/charge doesn't fix, contact warranty service.

faq.a: Most personal care devices have 1-2 year warranty.
Cleaning and reset usually fix common issues.
